DEF-197.title: regs.coppa outside {0,1} produces no finding at all
DEF-197.expected: OpenRTB 2.6 §3.2.3 types Regs.coppa as an integer flag limited to 0 or 1 ("Flag indicating if this request is subject to the COPPA regulations"). A value outside that pair (e.g. 2) is not a value the field can hold and should be reported.
DEF-197.actual: rules-request.js only inspects regs.coppa inside `if (req.regs && req.regs.coppa === 1)`, to cross-check PII fields when the flag is set. Any other value, valid or not, takes neither branch and produces no finding.
notes: Normative assertion authored from the OpenRTB 2.6 §3.2.3 Regs field table before execution; the known-gap signature documents the observed absence of any finding, not an expected output snapshot.

packages/core/crosscheck.js never reads regs.coppa at all, so this is a request-validation-only gap, confirmed by the case's own crosscheck assertions passing cleanly (identical to the unmodified base pair).

DEF-302.title: Request without site or app is rejected although OpenRTB marks both as recommended
DEF-302.expected: OpenRTB 2.5/2.6 §3.2.1 lists site and app as recommended; a request carrying neither remains valid and may receive guidance, not an error.
DEF-302.actual: Core emits request.no_site_or_app at ERROR and the request status becomes errors.
notes: Same class as DEF-100 (optional Device treated as mandatory).
